import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-03-08')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]).union(vix.index)); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=vix.reindex(idx).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
vix_z=(v-v.rolling(252,min_periods=100).mean())/(v.rolling(252,min_periods=100).std()+1e-9)
stress=(1+0.5*vix_z.clip(-1,2)).clip(0.25,2.0)
f=(-r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum().mul(stress,axis=0)).shift(1)
print('factor vix_state_reversal_5d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280309_vix_state_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-03-22')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Defensive relative strength: medium-horizon asset return relative to equity-benchmark return,
# risk-adjusted by idiosyncratic realized volatility; lag one session.
eq=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX']
eqret=r[eq].mean(axis=1)
asset20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum(); eq20=eqret.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum()
rel=asset20.sub(eq20,axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(rel/(vol+1e-6)).shift(1)
print('factor defensive_relative_strength_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280323_defensive_relative_strength_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-04-05')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut]
v=vix['close'].reindex(px.index).ffill()
eq=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX']; eqret=r[eq].mean(axis=1)
rel=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum().sub(eqret.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum(),axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
defensive=rel/(vol+1e-6)
mom=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum()
# VIX stress regime: use defensive relative strength in elevated-volatility regimes,
# otherwise use ordinary momentum. Regime and signal are lagged.
stress=(v>v.rolling(60,min_periods=40).median()).astype(float)
f=defensive.where(stress==1,mom).shift(1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_relative_strength_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-04-19')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility-scaled medium-term trend; all inputs lagged one completed session.
mom=r.rolling(40,min_periods=40).sum(); vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(mom/(vol+1e-6)).shift(1)
print('factor volscaled_momentum_40d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280420_volscaled_momentum_40d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut]
v=vix['close'].reindex(px.index).ffill()
eq=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX']; eqret=r[eq].mean(axis=1)
rel=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum().sub(eqret.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum(),axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
defensive=rel/(vol+1e-6)
mom=r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum()
# VIX stress regime: use defensive relative strength in elevated-volatility regimes,
# otherwise use ordinary momentum. Regime and signal are lagged.
stress=(v>v.rolling(60,min_periods=40).median()).astype(float)
f=defensive.where(stress==1,mom).shift(1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_relative_strength_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280406_vix_conditioned_relative_strength_signal.csv',index_label='date')
"}

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-05-03')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Trend persistence: medium-term return, scaled by realized risk and consistency of signed daily moves.
ret=r.rolling(30,min_periods=30).sum(); vol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
cons=r.gt(0).rolling(30,min_periods=25).mean()*2-1
f=(ret/(vol+1e-6)*cons).shift(1)
print('factor trend_persistence_volscaled_30d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280504_trend_persistence_volscaled_30d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-05-03')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Cross-asset residual momentum: asset 60d return minus contemporaneous equal-weight universe return.
base=r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum(); mkt=base.mean(axis=1); f=(base.sub(mkt,axis=0)).shift(1)
print('factor residual_momentum_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-05-17')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Momentum acceleration: recent 20-session return relative to the preceding 40-session return.
# Lag one completed session to avoid look-ahead.
r20=px.pct_change(20); r60=px.pct_change(60)
f=(r20-r60/3).shift(1)
print('factor momentum_acceleration_20_60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2024+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2024-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280518_momentum_acceleration_20_60_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-05-31')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside-risk-adjusted momentum acceleration, lagged one completed session.
acc=px.pct_change(20)-px.pct_change(60)/3
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()
f=(acc/(down+1e-6)).shift(1)
print('factor downside_adjusted_acceleration_20_60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2024+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2024-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-06-14')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility-scaled 20d momentum, with a confirmation multiplier for positive 60d trend.
ret20=px.pct_change(20); ret60=px.pct_change(60); vol20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(ret20/(vol20+1e-8)*(1+0.5*(ret60>0))).shift(1)
print('factor trend_alignment_volscaled_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2024+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2024-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280615_trend_alignment_volscaled_20d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-06-28')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Trend-quality factor: volatility-scaled 20d return multiplied by 20d path efficiency.
ret20=px.pct_change(20); vol20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(20)
eff=ret20.abs()/(r.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=10).sum()+1e-8)
f=(ret20/(vol20+1e-8)*eff).shift(1)
print('factor trend_quality_volscaled_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2024+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2024-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280629_trend_quality_volscaled_20d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-07-12')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
ret20=px.pct_change(20); vol20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(20)
eff=ret20.abs()/(r.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=10).sum()+1e-8)
f=(ret20/(vol20+1e-8)*eff).shift(1)
print('factor revalidation universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280713_trend_quality_revalidation_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-07-26')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Multi-horizon trend consistency: average volatility-normalized returns at 5/10/20d,
# multiplied by directional breadth (fraction of positive daily observations).
parts=[]
for h in [5,10,20]:
 ret=px.pct_change(h); vol=r.rolling(h,min_periods=max(5,h//2)).std()*np.sqrt(h)
 parts.append(ret/(vol+1e-8))
z=pd.concat(parts,axis=0,keys=['5','10','20']).groupby(level=1).mean()
bread=(r>0).rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean()
f=(z*(0.5+0.5*bread)).shift(1)
print('factor multi_horizon_consistency_5_10_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280727_multihorizon_consistency_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-08-09')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change(); m=r.mean(axis=1)
# Residual momentum: remove each asset's rolling 60d beta to the equal-weight tradable benchmark,
# then score its 20d cumulative residual return, volatility-normalized. Lag one day.
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(m).div(m.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=r.sub(beta.mul(m,axis=0)); resid_vol=res.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(res.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()/(resid_vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor residual_momentum_20d_beta60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-08-23')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items() for s in [s]}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Breakout persistence: location in 60-session range, discounted by recent gap/range volatility.
hi=px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max(); lo=px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min()
location=(px-lo)/(hi-lo+1e-12)-0.5
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
f=(location/(vol*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor breakout_location_volscaled universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-09-06')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside asymmetry quality: upside average relative to downside magnitude,
# multiplied by fraction of positive sessions. Lagged one session.
pos=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
neg=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
upfrac=(r>0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
f=((pos/(neg+1e-8))*upfrac).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('factor downside_asymmetry_quality_30d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-09-20')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Drawdown persistence: current drawdown from trailing 60d high, scaled by realized volatility.
# Less negative (closer to highs) is preferred; lagged one session.
high=px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()
dd=px/high-1
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(dd/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor drawdown_persistence_volscaled_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280921_drawdown_persistence_volscaled_signal.csv',index_label='date')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-09-06')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside asymmetry quality: upside average relative to downside magnitude,
# multiplied by fraction of positive sessions. Lagged one session.
pos=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
neg=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
upfrac=(r>0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
f=((pos/(neg+1e-8))*upfrac).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('factor downside_asymmetry_quality_30d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280907_downside_asymmetry_quality_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-10-04')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Stress-reversal: lagged oversold 5-session return amplified when short volatility is elevated
# versus its 60-session baseline. Intended as a distinct conditional mean-reversion signal.
rv20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); rv60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
stress=(rv20/(rv60+1e-8)).clip(0.25,4.0)
f=(-r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum()*stress).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor stress_reversal_volshock_5d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281005_stress_reversal_volshock_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-10-04')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Quality of trend: medium-horizon return divided by downside volatility; lagged one day.
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum()/(down+1e-8)).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor downside_risk_adjusted_trend_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y'];cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-10-04')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U};idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]));px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill();r=px.pct_change()
# Medium momentum normalized by recent realized risk, lagged one session.
f=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor momentum_vol_normalized_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I);ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk];print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()));f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281005_mom_volnorm_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-10-18')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Defensive stability: inverse downside semideviation over 40 sessions, combined with
# mildly positive 60d trend. Signal is lagged one day; higher values favor stable assets.
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
trend=px.pct_change(60)
f=(trend/(1+down*4)).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor defensive_stable_trend_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281019_defensive_stable_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))

rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-09-20')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Drawdown persistence: current drawdown from trailing 60d high, scaled by realized volatility.
# Less negative (closer to highs) is preferred; lagged one session.
high=px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()
dd=px/high-1
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(dd/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor drawdown_persistence_volscaled_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280921_drawdown_persistence_volscaled_signal.csv',index_label='date')

## Explored Factors

1. **Defensive Stable Trend**
   - Construction: 60-day momentum divided by \(1 + 4 \times\) 40-day downside volatility.
   - Higher values favor assets with positive trend and lower downside risk.
   - Signal lagged one session to avoid look-ahead bias.
   - Motivation: improve defensive diversification after recent momentum-cluster weakness.

2. **Inverse 20-Day Volatility**
   - Construction: inverse of 20-day annualized realized volatility.
   - Signal lagged one session.
   - Motivation: test a low-volatility allocation sleeve that could complement momentum factors.

## Validation Results

Validation cutoff: **2028-10-18**  
Validation date: **2028-10-19**  
Universe: **15 tradable instruments**  
All tests used at least 8 valid instruments per date; average cross-section was 15 instruments.

| Factor | Horizon | IC | ICIR | Valid dates | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| Inverse 20d volatility | 20d | -0.025850 | -0.076618 | 2,941 | 99.99% | 0.025661 | Failed |

Neither candidate met the benchmark admission gates of absolute daily paper IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840** on the same validation horizon. The inverse-volatility factor had low turnover but its ICIR remained below the threshold.

Recent 2028 performance was materially stronger for both candidates, particularly at the 20-day horizon:

- Defensive stable trend: IC **0.144282**, ICIR **0.486787**
- Inverse volatility: IC **0.128002**, ICIR **0.463367**

However, this recent strength was not supported across the full historical sample. The 2026+ and 2027+ diagnostics were weak or negative, so the apparent 2028 improvement was treated as regime-specific and insufficient for admission.

## Persistence Actions

- No factors persisted.

The previously admitted factor remains effective based on its latest recorded validation:

- `miner_3_20281005_momentum_vol_normalized_20d`
  - 20-day IC: **0.058949**

  - Coverage: **99.99%**
  - Turnover: **0.081733**
  - Validated: **2028-10-05**
  - Maximum aligned library correlation: **0.999971**

It remains highly redundant with the existing momentum library and should retain limited incremental ensemble weight.

## Plans

- Continue testing defensive factors with explicit regime conditioning rather than unconditional low-volatility exposure.
- Explore cross-asset relative-strength and market-stress rotation signals using macro observation-only series such as VIX and DXY, without submitting orders for those instruments.
- Test residualized defensive signals orthogonalized against the existing momentum cluster.
- Revalidate the admitted momentum factor using post-2028 performance and monitor whether its recent effectiveness persists outside the strong 2028 regime.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-11-01')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Tail-recovery momentum: 60d return divided by the magnitude of the worst peak-to-trough drawdown in the prior 60 sessions.
# It rewards persistent advances while penalizing assets whose trend was achieved through deep losses.
rollmax=px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()
dd=px/rollmax-1
worst=(-dd).rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()
f=(px.pct_change(60)/(1+worst*2)).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor tail_recovery_momentum_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281102_tail_recovery_momentum_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-11-01')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])|set(v.index)); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=v.reindex(idx).ffill()
# VIX-conditioned trend: 20d momentum is scaled down in unusually stressed volatility regimes;
# the regime multiplier is common across assets, while ranking remains momentum-based.
vr=(v/v.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()).clip(0.5,2.5)
f=(px.pct_change(20)/(1+2*(vr-1).clip(lower=0))).shift(1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_trend_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281102_vix_conditioned_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-11-01')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}

idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])|set(v.index)); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=v.reindex(idx).ffill()
vr=(v/v.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()).clip(0.5,2.5)
# apply common stress multiplier by date (not cross-sectional column alignment)
mult=(1+2*(vr-1).clip(lower=0)).to_numpy()[:,None]
f=(px.pct_change(20).to_numpy()/mult); f=pd.DataFrame(f,index=px.index,columns=px.columns).shift(1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_trend_20d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281102_vix_conditioned_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-11-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])|set(v.index)); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=v.reindex(idx).ffill()
vr=(v/v.rolling(90,min_periods=60).mean()).clip(.5,2.5)
# Longer trend plus stress attenuation; lagged one completed session.
mult=(1+1.5*(vr-1).clip(lower=0)).to_numpy()[:,None]
f=pd.DataFrame(px.pct_change(40).to_numpy()/mult,index=px.index,columns=px.columns).shift(1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_trend_40d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-11-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change(); m=r['SPX']
# residualized 40d momentum: rolling beta to SPX, residual cumulative return, lagged.
beta=r.rolling(120,min_periods=60).cov(m).div(m.rolling(120,min_periods=60).var(),axis=0)
res=r.sub(beta.mul(m,axis=0),axis=0)
f=res.rolling(40,min_periods=30).sum().shift(1)
print('factor residual_momentum_40d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281116_residual_momentum40_signal.csv',index_label='date')

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2028-11-29')
prices={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=4000)
    if d is None or len(d)==0: continue
    d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d[d.date<=cutoff].sort_values('date')
    prices[s]=d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index().ffill()
ret=px.pct_change()
# equal-weight market proxy formed only from available same-day returns
mkt=ret.mean(axis=1)
beta=ret.rolling(120,min_periods=80).cov(mkt)/mkt.rolling(120,min_periods=80).var()
res=ret.sub(beta.mul(mkt,axis=0),axis=0)
sig=res.rolling(40,min_periods=35).sum().shift(1)
fwd=px.shift(-20)/px-1
rows=[]
for dt in sig.index:
    x=sig.loc[dt]; y=fwd.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
        rows.append((dt,float(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1])),len(z)))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
# turnover rank signal, average absolute normalized rank change
rank=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turnover=rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
print('cutoff',cutoff.date(),'assets',len(px.columns),'dates',len(r),'avg_n',r.n.mean(),'coverage',r.n.mean()/len(U))
print('IC',r.ic.mean(),'ICIR',r.ic.mean()/r.ic.std(ddof=1),'hit', (r.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',turnover)
for label, start in [('2020+', '2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2027+','2027-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01')]:
 q=r[r.index>=start]; print(label,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
out='scripts/miner_3_20281130_equal_residual_momentum_signal.csv'; os.makedirs('scripts',exist_ok=True)
sig.to_csv(out,index_label='date'); print('artifact',out)

## Equal-Weight Residual Momentum Exploration

- Reviewed prior state: SPX-based 40-day residual momentum passed admission at the 20-day horizon on 2028-11-16, but its correlation audit remained pending and performance was concentrated in the strong 2028 regime.
- Tested an alternative residual construction using a **cross-asset equal-weight market proxy** across all 15 tradable instruments:
  - 120-day rolling beta estimated against the equal-weight average return.
  - Asset residual returns summed over 40 days.
  - Signal lagged one completed session.
  - Evaluated against 20-day forward returns through **2028-11-29**.
- Initial implementation using `get_index_daily_data` failed because the expected index files were unavailable. The process was corrected to use `get_stock_daily_data`; rolling covariance was then implemented explicitly to avoid the resulting alignment issue.

## Validation Results

- Valid dates: **2,793**
- Average instruments: **14.998**
- Coverage: **99.99%**
- IC: **0.055513**
- ICIR: **0.133084**
- Hit ratio: **55.57%**
- Approximate turnover: **0.051063**

Regime diagnostics:

- 2026+: IC **0.038466**, ICIR **0.084734**, 796 dates
- 2027+: IC **0.048848**, ICIR **0.127415**, 479 dates
- 2028+: IC **0.097673**, ICIR **0.285907**, 218 dates

The equal-weight residual variant is stronger than the previously tested SPX-residual version on full-sample IC/ICIR and shows improved diversification potential, but recent-period concentration remains material.

## Artifacts and Next Steps

- Signal artifact generated:
  - `scripts/miner_3_20281130_equal_residual_momentum_signal.csv`
- No factor metadata was persisted or marked effective yet.
- Next actions:
  - Recompute deterministic correlations against the existing factor library.
  - Compare directly with the effective SPX-residual factor and existing momentum/trend factors.
  - Assess whether the improvement survives alternative minimum-history rules and out-of-sample/live observations before assigning meaningful portfolio weight.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-12-13')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# directional path-efficiency trend: net 60d move divided by total absolute daily movement, lagged one day
net=px.pct_change(60); path=r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum(); f=(net/path).shift(1)
print('factor path_efficiency_trend_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281214_path_efficiency_trend_60d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

f=(px.pct_change(60).div(r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std())).shift(1)

  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()

   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))

rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281214_trend_quality_sharpe_60d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-12-13')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# short-horizon contrarian impulse, scaled by recent volatility and lagged one day
f=(-px.pct_change(5).div(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std())).shift(1)
print('factor volatility_scaled_reversal_5d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281214_vol_scaled_reversal_5d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

   - Construction: 60-day return divided by 60-day realized daily volatility, lagged by one day.
   - Motivation: identify trends with stronger risk-adjusted persistence.

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2028-12-14

### Explored Factors

1. **60-day path-efficiency trend**
   - Construction:  
     \[
     \frac{\text{60-day price change}}{\sum_{t=1}^{60}|\text{daily return}_t|}
     \]
     lagged by one day.
   - Motivation: distinguish persistent directional trends from noisy price movement.

2. **60-day trend-quality Sharpe**
   - Construction: 60-day return divided by 60-day realized daily volatility, lagged by one day.
   - Motivation: identify trends with stronger risk-adjusted persistence.

3. **5-day volatility-scaled reversal**
   - Construction: negative 5-day return divided by 20-day realized volatility, lagged by one day.
   - Motivation: test short-term mean reversion while controlling for asset-specific volatility.

### Validation Results

Validation used all 15 tradable benchmark instruments, with data through **2028-12-13**. Dates with at least eight valid instruments were accepted.

| Factor | Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Path-efficiency trend | 5d | 2,951 | 14.97 | 0.012541 | 0.039050 | 0.052037 | Failed ICIR gate |
| Path-efficiency trend | 10d | 2,946 | 14.97 | 0.010882 | 0.033591 | 0.052037 | Failed ICIR gate |
| Path-efficiency trend | 20d | 2,936 | 14.98 | 0.011150 | 0.033224 | 0.052037 | Failed ICIR gate |
| Trend-quality Sharpe | 5d | 2,951 | 14.97 | 0.012911 | 0.039836 | 0.052019 | Failed ICIR gate |
| Trend-quality Sharpe | 10d | 2,946 | 14.97 | 0.010395 | 0.031669 | 0.052019 | Failed ICIR gate |
| Trend-quality Sharpe | 20d | 2,936 | 14.98 | 0.009868 | 0.029124 | 0.052019 | Failed ICIR gate |
| Volatility-scaled reversal | 5d | 2,996 | 14.96 | 0.000501 | 0.001622 | 0.157267 | Failed |
| Volatility-scaled reversal | 10d | 2,991 | 14.96 | -0.000975 | -0.003113 | 0.157267 | Failed |
| Volatility-scaled reversal | 20d | 2,981 | 14.96 | -0.016128 | -0.051180 | 0.157267 | Failed |

Admission thresholds were absolute daily paper **IC ≥ 0.0070** and absolute daily paper **ICIR ≥ 0.0840**. None of the candidates satisfied both thresholds on the full validation sample.

The trend candidates showed strong recent 2028 behavior but weak full-sample stability. For example, the 20-day path-efficiency trend had 2028 IC/ICIR of **0.099431 / 0.341934**, but full-period ICIR was only **0.033224**. This is insufficient evidence for persistence and suggests possible regime dependence.

### Persistence Actions

- Research scripts and signal artifacts were generated:
  - `scripts/miner_3_20281214_path_efficiency_trend_60d.py`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20281214_path_efficiency_trend_60d_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20281214_trend_quality_sharpe_60d.py`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20281214_trend_quality_sharpe_60d_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20281214_vol_scaled_reversal_5d.py`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20281214_vol_scaled_reversal_5d_signal.csv`
- **No factors were persisted as EFFECTIVE**, because no candidate passed the benchmark-wide IC/ICIR admission gates.
- No library-correlation metadata was recorded because no factor qualified for persistence.

### Current Effective Factors

Existing effective factors remain unchanged. The latest previously persisted factor from this miner cycle history is the recovery-confirmed trend factor, while other effective library entries should continue to be monitored for redundancy and regime drift.

### Plans

- Re-test path-efficiency and trend-quality factors with:
  - regime conditioning using observation-only VIX and DXY;
  - downside-volatility normalization;
  - multi-horizon confirmation;
  - stricter rolling and walk-forward validation.
- Investigate whether the strong 2028 trend signal is robust after controlling for common cross-asset beta.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-12-27')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Relative momentum: asset 40d return minus contemporaneous cross-sectional median, scaled by own 20d volatility; lagged one completed day.
mom=px.pct_change(40); rel=mom.sub(mom.median(axis=1),axis=0); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252); f=(rel/(vol+1e-12)).shift(1)
print('factor relative_momentum_volscaled_40d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); N.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]
  print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20281228_relative_momentum_volscaled_40d_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-12-13')

# directional path-efficiency trend: net 60d move divided by total absolute daily movement, lagged one day
net=px.pct_change(60); path=r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum(); f=(net/path).shift(1)

 I=[];N=[];ds=[]

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2028-12-28

### Explored Factors

1. **40-day cross-sectional relative momentum, volatility scaled**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{R_{40d,i}-\operatorname{median}_j(R_{40d,j})}
     {\sqrt{252}\cdot \sigma_{20d,i}}
     \]
   - The signal is lagged by one completed trading day.
   - Motivation: identify assets exhibiting persistent relative strength while reducing preference for assets whose momentum is primarily explained by unusually high volatility.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Observation-only macro instruments were not traded or included as assets.

### Validation Results

Data was validated through **2028-12-27**, using 2020-01-01 through 2028-12-27 and dates with at least eight valid instruments.

| Horizon | Valid dates | Average instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage | Turnover | Result |

The 20-day horizon passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: **0.030498**, above 0.0070
- Absolute ICIR: **0.089362**, above 0.0840

Regime results for the 20-day horizon:

- 2020–2025: IC **0.038656**, ICIR **0.114825**, 2,150 dates
- 2026 onward: IC **0.009003**, ICIR **0.025540**, 816 dates
- 2027 onward: IC **0.034390**, ICIR **0.113510**, 499 dates
- 2028 onward: IC **0.137095**, ICIR **0.483394**, 238 dates

The factor has strong recent performance but meaningful regime dependence. The reported maximum absolute library correlation is **0.968360**, primarily against an existing relative-strength artifact. This candidate should therefore be treated as a highly redundant refinement rather than an independent source of alpha. The deterministic downstream correlation gate should recompute correlation from the signal artifacts.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and read back successfully:

- `factors/relative_momentum_volscaled_40d.json`
- Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20281228_relative_momentum_volscaled_40d_signal.csv`

- 20-day IC and ICIR

- Signal provenance
- Library-correlation metadata
- Admission thresholds and regime notes

### Current Effective Factors

The newly validated factor is currently marked effective:

- **relative_momentum_volscaled_40d**
  - 20-day IC: **0.030498**
  - 20-day ICIR: **0.089362**
  - Coverage: **99.99%**
  - Turnover: **0.063515**
  - Last validated: **2028-12-28**

Existing effective library factors remain subject to downstream redundancy checks and periodic revalidation. Because this factor is highly correlated with an existing relative-strength signal, portfolio construction should avoid simply assigning additive exposure to both.

### Plans

- Revalidate the new factor over the next quarterly window, with special attention to the weak 2026-plus aggregate regime.
- Test residualization against the existing relative-strength factor to determine whether any incremental predictive information remains.
- Explore lower-correlation variants using downside-volatility scaling, beta-neutralization, or trend persistence rather than another raw momentum transformation.
- Monitor the defensive ensemble’s recent deterioration and investigate whether momentum signals should receive reduced weight until broader regime confirmation appears.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-10')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside-adjusted intermediate trend: 20-day return divided by 40-day downside volatility, lagged one day.
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(px.pct_change(20)/(down+1e-12)).shift(1)
print('factor downside_adjusted_trend_20d_40d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]
  print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290111_downside_adjusted_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')
