import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-24')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Trend breadth: fraction of positive sessions in trailing 40d, scaled by annualized volatility; lagged one completed day.
breadth=(r.gt(0).rolling(40,min_periods=30).mean()-0.5)*2
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(breadth/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor breadth_vol_quality universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   z=spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic; I.append(z);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290125_breadth_vol_quality_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-02-07')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Recovery stability: location in 60d range, weighted by persistence of positive returns and penalized by drawdown variability; lag one day.
lo=px.rolling(60,min_periods=45).min(); hi=px.rolling(60,min_periods=45).max()
location=(px-lo)/(hi-lo+1e-8)
breadth=r.gt(0).rolling(30,min_periods=24).mean()
down=r.clip(upper=0).pow(2).rolling(30,min_periods=24).mean().pow(.5)*np.sqrt(252)
f=(location*(2*breadth-0.5)/(1+down)).shift(1)
print('factor recovery_stability_60d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-02-21')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility-normalized acceleration: recent 10d trend minus slower 60d trend,
# scaled by 30d realized volatility and conditioned on efficient (low-chop) paths.
fast=px.pct_change(10); slow=px.pct_change(60)
vol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=24).std()*np.sqrt(252)
eff=px.diff(20).abs().div(px.diff().abs().rolling(20,min_periods=16).sum()+1e-12)
f=((fast-slow)/(vol+0.05)*(0.5+eff)).shift(1)
print('factor vol_accel_eff_10_60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mask]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290222_vol_accel_eff_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-02-21')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}; idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Stable asymmetry: reward positive-return share and upside mean, penalize downside magnitude and total volatility.
pos=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(40,min_periods=32).mean(); neg=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(40,min_periods=32).mean(); vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std(); breadth=r.gt(0).rolling(40,min_periods=32).mean()
f=((pos/(neg+1e-5))*(2*breadth-0.5)/(vol+0.01)).shift(1)
print('factor stable_asymmetry_40_60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mask]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum())); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290222_stable_asymmetry_signal.csv',index_label='date')

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-02-22

### Explored Factors

   - Construction: 10-day return minus 60-day return, divided by 30-day annualized volatility and multiplied by a 20-day path-efficiency term.

     \[
     F_{i,t}=
     \frac{
     \left(\overline{r^+}_{40}/(\overline{r^-}_{40}+10^{-5})\right)
     \left(2\cdot\text{positive-day breadth}_{40}-0.5\right)
     }{
     \sigma_{60}+\text{constant}
     }

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-03-07')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility-scaled short-term reversal, gated toward assets whose medium-term trend is not severely negative.
# Lag one completed day. Reversal is expected to capture cross-asset snapback while drawdown gate avoids distressed trends.
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); short=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum(); trend=r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum(); gate=(1/(1+np.maximum(-trend,0)*4)); f=((-short/(vol+0.01))*gate).shift(1)
print('factor reversal_drawdown_gated_5_60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-03-07')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()

# scaled by idiosyncratic recent volatility and activated when cross-sectional dispersion is elevated.
ret5=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum(); csmean=ret5.mean(axis=1); disp=ret5.sub(csmean,axis=0).std(axis=1).rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); f=(-(ret5.sub(csmean,axis=0))/(vol+0.01)*(disp/(disp+0.01))).shift(1)
print('factor xs_residual_reversal_5d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mask]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum())); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290308_xs_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-03-21')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Persistence-adjusted downside trend: medium-horizon return, penalized by downside volatility,
# and weighted by path efficiency to prefer persistent advances over choppy rallies.
ret20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum(); down=r.clip(upper=0).pow(2).rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean().pow(.5)
eff=ret20.abs()/(r.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()+.01)
f=(ret20/(down+.01))*eff
f=f.shift(1)
print('factor persistence_downside_trend_20_40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mask]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-03-22

### Explored Factors

1. **Persistence-adjusted downside trend**
   - Construction: 20-day cumulative return divided by 40-day downside volatility, multiplied by 20-day path efficiency.
   - Path efficiency is defined as absolute cumulative return divided by cumulative absolute daily returns.
   - Signal is lagged by one completed trading day to avoid look-ahead bias.
   - Motivation: favor persistent trends while penalizing assets whose gains are accompanied by substantial downside volatility or choppy price paths.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable instruments.
   - Average cross-section: 15 instruments.
   - Minimum cross-section: 8.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Result |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 5d | 3,056 | 15.00 | 99.99% | 0.012477 | 0.038407 | 51.57% | Failed ICIR |
| 10d | 3,051 | 15.00 | 99.99% | 0.034653 | 0.107056 | 53.29% | Passed |
| 20d | 3,041 | 15.00 | 99.99% | **0.054333** | **0.165685** | 55.24% | **Passed** |

- Turnover: **0.081970**
- Validation period: **2020-01-01 through 2029-03-21**
- Benchmark gates: absolute IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840
- Admission horizon: **20 trading days**

#### Regime Analysis

| Regime | Dates | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020–2025 | 2,165 | 0.065316 | 0.200418 |
| 2026 onward | 876 | 0.027189 | 0.082013 |
| 2028 onward | 298 | 0.095038 | 0.335109 |

The factor remained positive across all tested regimes, although its ICIR during 2026 onward was slightly below the benchmark threshold when evaluated in isolation. Performance strengthened materially during 2028 onward.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/persistence_downside_trend_20_40.json`
  - Status: `EFFECTIVE`
  - Version: `1.0`
  - Last validated: `2029-03-22`
  - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290322_persistence_downside_trend_signal.csv`
  - `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null`; deterministic downstream correlation recomputation remains required.

### Current Effective Factors

- **persistence_downside_trend_20_40**
  - 20-day IC: **0.054333**
  - 20-day ICIR: **0.165685**
  - Coverage: **99.99%**
  - Turnover: **0.081970**
  - Valid dates: **3,041**
  - Recency: validated 2029-03-22

- **stable_asymmetry_40_60**
  - Previously validated 2029-03-08
  - 20-day IC: **0.027261**
  - 20-day ICIR: **0.084813**
  - Coverage: **99.99%**
  - Turnover: **0.058040**
  - Remains effective but is close to the admission threshold and materially regime-dependent.

### Plans

- Revalidate both effective factors after additional online observations.
- Test whether the new persistence-adjusted trend factor is redundant with existing trend and downside-momentum factors using deterministic signal-artifact correlations.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import pandas as pd,numpy as np\\nfrom scipy.stats import spearmanr\\nU=[\'000300.SH\',\'SPX\',\'HSI\',\'N225\',\'SX5E\',\'000688.SH\',\'SOX\',\'NDX\',\'XAU\',\'COPPER\',\'WTI\',\'BTC\',\'ETH\',\'US10Y\',\'CN10Y\']; cut=pd.Timestamp(\'2029-05-02\')\\nP={s:pd.read_csv(\'../persistent/stock_data/\'+s+\'.csv\',parse_dates=[\'date\']).drop_duplicates(\'date\').set_index(\'date\').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}\\nidx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()\\n# Breadth-confirmed acceleration: medium return, persistence of positive days,\\n# and recent acceleration, penalized by downside volatility. import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-05-16')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Dispersion-gated cross-sectional residual reversal: fade 5d relative return, with stronger signal in elevated dispersion.
ret5=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum(); cs=ret5.mean(axis=1); disp=ret5.sub(cs,axis=0).std().rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); f=(-(ret5.sub(cs,axis=0))/(vol+0.01)).mul(disp/(disp+0.01),axis=0).shift(1)
print('factor dispersion_gated_residual_reversal_5d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mask]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))

## Explored Factors

1. **Dispersion-gated cross-sectional residual reversal**
   - Fades each instrument’s 5-day return relative to the cross-sectional mean.
   - Scales by inverse 20-day volatility and gates intensity using 20-day cross-sectional return dispersion.
   - Signal lagged by one day to avoid look-ahead bias.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments.

2. **Defensive volatility-breadth quality**
   - Combines inverse 20-day volatility, positive-return-day breadth, and capped 20-day return.
   - Intended to identify stable assets with persistent positive participation.
   - Signal lagged by one day.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2029-05-17**, using data through **2029-05-16**. Each test used approximately 15 instruments per date and over 3,000 historical dates.

### Dispersion-gated residual reversal

| Horizon | Dates | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5 days | 3,106 | 0.011093 | 0.034464 | 50.71% | 99.99% |
| 10 days | 3,101 | 0.005551 | 0.016880 | 49.31% | 99.99% |
| 20 days | 3,091 | -0.005483 | -0.016656 | 49.53% | 99.99% |

- Rank turnover: **0.156662**
- Regime behavior was unstable:
  - 2020–2025, 5-day IC: 0.022443
  - 2026 onward, 5-day IC: -0.015423
  - 2028 onward, 10-day IC: -0.020761
  - 2029 YTD, 10-day IC: -0.024026
- **Failed admission gates** at all tested horizons.

### Defensive volatility-breadth quality

| Horizon | Dates | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5 days | 3,106 | -0.009278 | -0.027363 | 47.52% | 99.99% |
| 10 days | 3,101 | -0.013848 | -0.041522 | 47.98% | 99.99% |
| 20 days | 3,091 | -0.003549 | -0.010565 | 50.66% | 99.99% |

- Rank turnover: **0.037940**
- Recent regime performance improved:
  - 2028 onward, 10-day IC/ICIR: 0.094109 / 0.334702
  - 2028 onward, 20-day IC/ICIR: 0.153001 / 0.565285
  - 2029 YTD, 10-day IC/ICIR: 0.040097 / 0.169606
  - 2029 YTD, 20-day IC/ICIR: 0.038690 / 0.174007
- However, full-history IC did not meet the required benchmark thresholds. The factor therefore **failed admission**.

## Persistence Actions

- No factors persisted.
- Both candidates failed the full-history IC/ICIR admission requirements.
- Signal artifacts were generated for audit and future research:
  - `scripts/miner_3_20290517_dispersion_gated_reversal_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20290517_defensive_vol_quality_signal.csv`

## Current Effective Factors

Existing effective factors remain unchanged, including:

- `miner_3_20290503_breadth_confirmed_accel_downside_20_40.json`
  - Latest reported 20-day IC: 0.046586
  - ICIR: 0.136648
  - Validated: 2029-05-03
  - Recent 2029 YTD deterioration remains under monitoring.

No new effective factor was added this cycle.

## Plans

- Revalidate the defensive volatility-breadth signal over a longer live-period sample; its strong 2028–2029 performance warrants monitoring despite insufficient full-history admission metrics.
- Explore regime-conditional combinations that switch between defensive quality and trend signals based on macro volatility or cross-asset dispersion.
- Continue reducing dependence on crowded momentum/trend factors, particularly given weak recent portfolio results and negative recent trend-factor subsamples.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Trend persistence: medium trend, sign consistency, volatility normalization.
# Intended as a distinct, interpretable quality-of-trend signal.
frames={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=4000)
    if d is not None and len(d):
        d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date); frames[s]=d.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(frames).sort_index().ffill()
r=p.pct_change()
# lag all signal one completed day at each date
trend=p.pct_change(60)
bread=(r.rolling(20).gt(0).mean()-0.5)*2
vol=r.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
raw=trend*bread/(vol+1e-8)
sig=raw.shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20]:
    fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1
    vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
    for dt in sig.index:
        x=sig.loc[dt]; y=fwd.loc[dt]
        z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8:
            vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
    a=np.array(vals); a=a[np.isfinite(a)]
    print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(float(np.mean(ns)),2),'IC',round(float(a.mean()),6),'ICIR',round(float(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6)),'hit',round(float((a>0).mean()),4))
# rank turnover and coverage
rr=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
print('instruments',len(p.columns),'date_range',p.index.min().date(),p.index.max().date(),'coverage',float(sig.notna().sum().sum()/sig.size),'turnover',round(float(turn),6))
# regimes for selected horizon
h=20; fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: vals.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')))
v=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic']).set_index('date')
for label, start in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
 q=v.loc[start:]; print(label,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(float(q.ic.mean()),6),'ICIR',round(float(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6)) if len(q)>1 else None)
# artifact for audit
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290531_trend_persistence_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-05-30')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Trend persistence: 60-day trend times signed 20-day breadth, normalized by 40-day volatility.
f=(px.pct_change(60)*(2*(r.gt(0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()-.5))/(r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor trend_persistence_volscaled_60_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
# regime details at 20d
I=[];ds=[]
for i in range(len(px)-20):
 q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+20]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);ds.append(px.index[i])
v=pd.Series(I,index=ds)
for label,start in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
 q=v.loc[start:]; print(label,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290531_trend_persistence_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-05-30')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Contrarian orientation: negate a persistent, volatility-scaled 60-day trend.
f=(-px.pct_change(60)*(2*(r.gt(0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()-.5))/(r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor trend_persistence_contrarian_60_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290531_trend_persistence_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-06-13')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Short-horizon volatility-scaled reversal: yesterday-lagged negative 10d return, normalized by 20d realized volatility.
f=(-px.pct_change(10)/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=12).std()*np.sqrt(252)+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor short_reversal_volscaled_10_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290614_short_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-06-13')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility-scaled short-horizon momentum, lagged one day.
f=(px.pct_change(10)/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=12).std()*np.sqrt(252)+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor short_momentum_volscaled_10_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290614_short_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-06-27')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Residual momentum: asset 20d return minus equal-weight cross-asset benchmark return, divided by idiosyncratic 20d residual volatility; lag one day.
bench=r.mean(axis=1); ar=px.pct_change(20); br=bench.rolling(20,min_periods=12).sum(); resid=ar.sub(br,axis=0); rv=(r.sub(bench,axis=0).rolling(20,min_periods=12).std()*np.sqrt(252)); f=(resid/(rv+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor residual_momentum_volscaled_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290628_residual_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-07-11')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# 40-day cross-asset residual momentum, volatility scaled and lagged one day.
bench=r.mean(axis=1); ar=px.pct_change(40); br=bench.rolling(40,min_periods=24).sum(); resid=ar.sub(br,axis=0); rv=r.sub(bench,axis=0).rolling(40,min_periods=24).std()*np.sqrt(252); f=(resid/(rv+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor residual_momentum_volscaled_40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290712_residual_momentum40_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-07-25')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
bench=r.mean(axis=1); ar=px.pct_change(40); br=bench.rolling(40,min_periods=24).sum(); resid=ar.sub(br,axis=0)
rr=r.sub(bench,axis=0); down=rr.where(rr<0,0).rolling(40,min_periods=24).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(resid/(down+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor downside_residual_momentum40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[]; D=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));D.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for label,mask in [('2020-25',np.array(D)<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',np.array(D)>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',np.array(D)>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',np.array(D)>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  if len(z): print(' ',label,len(z),round(z.mean(),6),round(z.mean()/(z.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290726_downside_residual40_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-08-08')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Multi-horizon directional breadth: average of signed return direction over 5/10/20/40d,
# with recent horizons weighted more. Lag one completed day.
breadth=sum(w*(r.rolling(h,min_periods=max(3,h//2)).mean()>0).astype(float) for h,w in [(5,.35),(10,.30),(20,.20),(40,.15)])
# subtract contemporaneous cross-sectional average to make it relative, then lag
f=(breadth-breadth.mean(axis=1)).shift(1)
print('factor directional_breadth_5_40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];D=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));D.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); d=np.array(D)
 print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'dailyICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'annICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for label,mask in [('2020-25',d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  if len(z): print(' ',label,len(z),round(z.mean(),6),round(z.mean()/(z.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290809_directional_breadth_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-08-08')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
breadth=sum(w*(r.rolling(h,min_periods=max(3,h//2)).mean()>0).astype(float) for h,w in [(5,.35),(10,.30),(20,.20),(40,.15)])
f=breadth.sub(breadth.mean(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
print('factor directional_breadth_5_40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];D=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));D.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(D)
 print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'dailyICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'annICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for label,mask in [('2020-25',d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  if len(z): print(' ',label,len(z),round(z.mean(),6),round(z.mean()/(z.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290809_directional_breadth_signal.csv',index=False)

## Explored Factors

1. **Cross-asset directional breadth across 5–40 day horizons**
   - For each of the 15 tradable benchmark instruments, calculated the proportion of positive-return horizons using:
     - 5-day: 35%
     - 10-day: 30%
     - 20-day: 20%
     - 40-day: 15%
   - Centered scores against the contemporaneous cross-sectional mean.
   - Lagged the factor by one completed trading day.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290809_directional_breadth_signal.csv`

## Validation Results

Validation used all 15 instruments and dates through **2029-08-08**.

| Forward horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | Daily ICIR | Annualized ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 3,179 | 15.0 | 0.006522 | 0.021169 | 0.336043 | 50.68% |
| 10d | 3,174 | 15.0 | 0.014337 | 0.046541 | 0.738823 | 51.61% |
| **20d** | **3,164** | **15.0** | **0.029102** | **0.092358** | **1.466133** | **53.41%** |

Additional metrics:

- Coverage: **99.9686%**
- Rank turnover: **0.127159**
- Validation period: **2020-01-01 through 2029-08-08**
- Validation timestamp: **2029-08-09**
- `max_abs_library_correlation`: unavailable; persisted as `null`

The 20-day factor passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: **0.029102**, above **0.0070**
- Absolute daily ICIR: **0.092358**, above **0.0840**

Regime behavior was mixed:

| Regime | Dates | IC | Daily ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020–2025 | 2,188 | 0.042454 | 0.134943 |
| 2026 onward | 976 | -0.000831 | -0.002644 |
| 2028 onward | 398 | 0.033330 | 0.120003 |
| 2029 YTD | 138 | -0.066315 | -0.280465 |

The strong full-history result is supported primarily by 2020–2025 and 2028 performance. The negative 2029 YTD result indicates current regime sensitivity and argues against unconstrained use.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20290809_directional_breadth_5_40.json`
- Status: **EFFECTIVE**
- Factor definition, dependencies, parameters, validation metrics, timestamp, and signal artifact reference verified
- JSON validity confirmed

## Current Effective Factors

Newly effective:

- **`miner_3_20290809_directional_breadth_5_40`**
  - 20-day IC: **0.029102**
  - Daily ICIR: **0.092358**
  - Coverage: **99.9686%**
  - Rank turnover: **0.127159**
  - Validated: **2029-08-09**
  - Regime flag: weak in 2026+ overall and materially negative in 2029 YTD

Previously effective residual-momentum factors remain relevant, including the 40-day downside-volatility-scaled variant. Their signal artifacts should undergo deterministic pairwise correlation analysis before assigning independent ensemble weights.

## Plans

- Revalidate the newly persisted breadth factor on rolling 3-, 6-, and 12-month windows.
- Compare its signal correlation with the residual-momentum family and existing defensive factors.
- Investigate regime-conditioned activation using volatility breadth and observation-only macro signals.
- Test whether shorter breadth horizons improve the factor’s recent 2029 behavior.
- Retain conservative allocation caps until recent-window performance recovers.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-08-22')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# directional breadth acceleration: recent 5/10-day sign breadth minus slow 20/40-day breadth
fast=.6*(r.rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()>0).astype(float)+.4*(r.rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()>0).astype(float)
slow=.6*(r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean()>0).astype(float)+.4*(r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).mean()>0).astype(float)
f=(fast-slow).sub((fast-slow).mean(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
print('factor breadth_acceleration universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];D=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));D.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(D)
 print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'dailyICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'annICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for label,mask in [('2020-25',d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  if len(z): print(' ',label,len(z),round(z.mean(),6),round(z.mean()/(z.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290823_breadth_acceleration_signal.csv',index=False)

## Explored Factors

1. **Directional breadth acceleration**
   - Compared fast positive-return breadth across 5- and 10-day windows with slower breadth across 20- and 40-day windows.
   - Lagged signals by one completed trading day.
   - Tested 5-, 10-, and 20-day forward returns.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290823_breadth_acceleration_signal.csv`

2. **Contrarian breadth deceleration**
   - Reversed the breadth-acceleration signal to test whether recently weakening breadth predicts mean reversion.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290823_contrarian_breadth_signal.csv`

3. **Revalidation of cross-asset directional breadth 5–40d**
   - Recomputed the previously effective factor using data through 2029-08-22.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290823_directional_breadth_reval_signal.csv`

## Validation Results

Validation used all 15 tradable instruments and 3,198 dates through 2029-08-22. Each valid cross-sectional IC observation contained all 15 instruments.

### Breadth acceleration

| Horizon | Valid dates | IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 3,183 | -0.022059 | -0.074772 | 46.09% |
| 10d | 3,178 | -0.024033 | -0.080571 | 46.54% |
| 20d | 3,168 | -0.019161 | -0.063433 | 45.99% |

Failed the admission gates. Not persisted.

### Contrarian breadth deceleration

| Horizon | Valid dates | IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 3,183 | 0.022059 | 0.074772 | 53.47% |
| 10d | 3,178 | 0.024033 | 0.080571 | 53.12% |
| 20d | 3,168 | 0.019161 | 0.063433 | 53.57% |

Although IC was positive, daily ICIR remained below the required 0.0840 threshold at all horizons. Not persisted.

### Directional breadth 5–40d revalidation

| Horizon | Valid dates | IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 3,189 | 0.005887 | 0.019116 | 50.58% |
| 10d | 3,184 | 0.014104 | 0.045828 | 51.54% |
| **20d** | **3,174** | **0.029463** | **0.093535** | **53.47%** |

Additional 20-day metrics:

- Average instruments: 15.0
- Coverage: 99.9687%
- Rank turnover: 0.132599
- Annualized ICIR: 1.485
- `max_abs_library_correlation`: unavailable; persisted as `null`

Recent-regime behavior:

- 2028 onward: IC 0.036037, daily ICIR 0.129745
- 2029 YTD: IC -0.052120, daily ICIR -0.213924

The factor passed the benchmark admission gates on the full validation period:

- Absolute IC: 0.029463 ≥ 0.0070
- Absolute daily ICIR: 0.093535 ≥ 0.0840

However, the materially negative 2029 YTD result confirms substantial regime sensitivity.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20290823_directional_breadth_5_40_revalidated.json`
- Status: `EFFECTIVE`
- Signal artifact and provenance fields included
- JSON validity, factor ID, status, thresholds, and validation metrics verified

The two breadth acceleration variants failed validation and were not persisted.

## Current Effective Factors

- **`miner_3_20290823_directional_breadth_5_40_revalidated`**
  - 20-day IC: 0.029463
  - Daily ICIR: 0.093535
  - Coverage: 99.9687%
  - Rank turnover: 0.132599
  - Validated: 2029-08-23
  - Full-history gates: passed
  - 2029 YTD: materially negative; retain conservative usage and monitor rolling decay

Previously effective factor-library entries remain subject to deterministic signal-correlation checks before independent ensemble weighting.

## Plans

- Revalidate this factor on rolling 3-, 6-, and 12-month windows.
- Test conditional activation using macro stress, volatility breadth, and observation-only VIX/DXY signals.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-05')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Relative volatility-adjusted reversal: recent 20d return, scaled by 20d realized vol; lag one day.
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std(); raw=-(px/px.shift(20)-1)/(vol*np.sqrt(20)+1e-12); f=raw.sub(raw.mean(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
print('vol_adjusted_reversal',len(px),px.index.max().date(),'assets',len(U))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];D=[]; Ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);D.append(px.index[i]);Ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(D)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for name,mask in [('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01')),('2029Aug+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-08-01'))]:
  x=a[mask]
  print(name,len(x),round(x.mean(),6) if len(x) else None,round(x.mean()/(x.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6) if len(x)>1 else None)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290906_vol_adjusted_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-05')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}; idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
b=sum(w*(r.rolling(h,min_periods=max(3,h//2)).mean()>0).astype(float) for h,w in [(5,.35),(10,.30),(20,.20),(40,.15)]); f=b.sub(b.mean(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
print('directional breadth current',len(px),px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];D=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);D.append(px.index[i]);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(D);print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'N',np.mean(N),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',(a>0).mean())
 for lab,m in [('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m];print(lab,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1))
print('coverage',f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,'turnover',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290906_directional_breadth_signal.csv',index=False)

## Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-adjusted reversal**
   - Construction: negative 20-day return divided by 20-day realized volatility, cross-sectionally centered and lagged one day.
   - Motivation: test whether risk-adjusted recent losers outperform, while controlling for heterogeneous asset volatility.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290906_vol_adjusted_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **Cross-asset directional breadth 5–40d revalidation**
   - Construction: weighted positive-return breadth over 5, 10, 20, and 40 trading days with weights 0.35/0.30/0.20/0.15, cross-sectionally centered and lagged one day.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290906_directional_breadth_signal.csv`

Validation used all 15 tradable instruments and 3,208 dates through 2029-09-05. Valid cross-sectional observations used approximately 15 instruments.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-19')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Risk-adjusted continuation: medium-term return divided by realized volatility, lagged to avoid look-ahead.
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).sum()/vol).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   z=spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic; I.append(z);ds.append(px.index[i]);ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d< pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m]
  print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
 rows.append((h,a.mean(),a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),len(a)))
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6),'assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290920_risk_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-19')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).sum()/vol).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 regimes=[('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]
 for lab,m in regimes:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6),'assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20290920_risk_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

1. **20-day volatility-adjusted momentum**
   - Construction: 20-day cumulative return divided by 20-day realized volatility, annualized and lagged one trading day.
   - Motivation: identify continuation while normalizing for heterogeneous cross-asset risk.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20290920_risk_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv`

## Validation Results

Validation used data through **2029-09-19**, with approximately 14.9 instruments per cross-section.

| Forward horizon | Valid dates | IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

- Absolute IC: **0.054682 ≥ 0.0070**
- Absolute daily ICIR: **0.171084 ≥ 0.0840**

- Coverage: **98.9579%**

- Universe size: **15**

Regime observations for the 20-day horizon:

- 2020–2025: IC **0.072080**, ICIR **0.228225**
- 2026 onward: IC **0.016980**, ICIR **0.052301**
- 2028 onward: IC **0.059729**, ICIR **0.201253**
- 2029 YTD: IC **-0.034537**, ICIR **-0.114041**

The factor is effective on the full validation sample but exhibits notable recent deterioration during 2029 YTD. Conservative portfolio weighting and rolling monitoring are warranted.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20290920_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d.json`

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-10-03')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility compression: long-horizon risk divided by recent risk; lagged to avoid look-ahead.
short=r.rolling(10,min_periods=8).std(); long=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
f=(long/short).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('factor=60d realized vol / 10d realized vol, lag1')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6),'assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291004_vol_compression_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-10-03')

short=r.rolling(10,min_periods=8).std(); long=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
f=(long/short).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('factor=60d realized vol / 10d realized vol, lag1')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))

 for lab,m in regimes:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6),'assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291004_vol_compression_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-10-17')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside asymmetry: lagged 40d average upside magnitude relative to downside magnitude.
up=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean(); dn=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean()
f=(up/(dn+1e-8)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('factor=40d upside/downside average magnitude ratio, lag1; assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291018_downside_asymmetry_signal.csv',index=False)

## Explored Factors

1. **40-day upside/downside magnitude asymmetry**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{\operatorname{mean}(\max(r,0),40)}
     {\operatorname{mean}(\max(-r,0),40)+10^{-8}}
     \]
     using a one-day lag.
   - Motivation: identify instruments whose recent positive-return magnitude has been favorable relative to their downside magnitude.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20291018_downside_asymmetry_signal.csv`

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2029-10-18**  
Validation data through: **2029-10-17**

| Forward horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| 20d | 3,191 | 15.0 | **0.027986** | **0.085423** | 52.68% |

The 20-day result passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: **0.027986 ≥ 0.0070**
- Absolute daily ICIR: **0.085423 ≥ 0.0840**
- Coverage: **99.16%**
- Rank turnover: **0.048665**
- Cross-sectional observations: **3,191 dates**
- Average cross-section: **15 instruments**
- Maximum observed library correlation: **0.653051**

Regime results were mixed:

- **2020–2025:** IC **0.044314**, ICIR **0.138167**
- **2026 onward:** IC **-0.006468**, ICIR **-0.019062**
- **2028 onward:** IC **0.031003**, ICIR **0.106458**
- **2029 YTD:** IC **-0.090881**, ICIR **-0.325688**

The factor has favorable full-sample statistics but substantial regime dependence and poor 2029 YTD performance. Given the small cross-sectional universe and recent deterioration, its effective status should be treated as provisional and its portfolio weight kept conservative.

## Persistence Actions

- `factors/miner_3_20291018_upside_downside_asymmetry_40d.json`

## Current Effective Factors

Known effective factors currently include:

- `miner_3_20290906_directional_breadth_5_40_revalidated`
- `miner_3_20290920_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d`
- `miner_3_20291018_upside_downside_asymmetry_40d`

The newly admitted asymmetry factor is highly correlated with an existing downside-adjusted momentum artifact at approximately **0.653**, so it should not receive an independent full-strength allocation. It is better suited as a low-weight risk-aware overlay or ensemble component.

## Plans

- Revalidate the new asymmetry factor using rolling 3-, 6-, and 12-month windows.
- Test whether the factor improves when conditioned on breadth, volatility, or macro regime.
- Monitor whether its negative 2029 YTD behavior persists before increasing its ensemble weight.
- Continue revalidation of directional breadth and risk-adjusted momentum, emphasizing post-2026 and recent-regime performance rather than full-sample metrics alone.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-10-31')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside-risk-adjusted medium momentum: recent 30d compounded return scaled by trailing 40d downside deviation.
down=r.clip(upper=0).pow(2).rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean().pow(.5)
f=((px/px.shift(30)-1)/(down+1e-8)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('factor=30d return / 40d downside deviation, lag1; assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291101_downside_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-11-14')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# interpretable trend consistency: signed breadth of daily returns, weighted toward recent observations
pos=(r>0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean(); neg=(r<0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
# penalize downside frequency; lag one day
f=(pos-neg).shift(1)
print('factor=30d signed return breadth (positive-frequency minus negative-frequency), lag1')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6),'assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291115_signed_breadth_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-11-14')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# residual 20d momentum relative to contemporaneous cross-sectional median, scaled by idiosyncratic 40d volatility
mom=px.pct_change(20); resid=mom.sub(mom.median(axis=1),axis=0); vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std(); f=(resid/vol).shift(1)
print('factor=20d cross-sectional residual momentum / 40d vol, lag1')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6),'assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291115_residual_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

## Explored Factors

1. **30-day signed return breadth**
   - Construction: rolling 30-day positive-return frequency minus negative-return frequency for each asset, lagged one trading day.
   - Motivation: identify persistent directional participation while avoiding look-ahead bias.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.

2. **20-day cross-sectional residual momentum scaled by 40-day volatility**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{R_{20,i}-\operatorname{median}_{j}(R_{20,j})}
     {\sigma_{40,i}}
     \]
     lagged one trading day.
   - Motivation: isolate relative momentum against the contemporaneous cross-asset median and penalize high-volatility instruments.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20291115_residual_momentum_signal.csv`

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2029-11-15**  
Data available through: **2029-11-14**  
Universe: **15 assets**, with approximately 15 instruments per valid date.

### Signed return breadth

| Horizon | Valid dates | IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1d | 3,237 | 0.002872 | 0.009676 | 49.80% |
| 5d | 3,233 | 0.016110 | 0.053757 | 52.95% |
| 10d | 3,228 | 0.024385 | 0.080518 | 53.66% |
| 20d | 3,218 | 0.034249 | 0.107671 | 53.29% |

The 20-day result exceeded the numerical admission gates, but its 2029 YTD performance was materially negative:

- 2020–2025 IC/ICIR: **0.063010 / 0.209034**
- 2026 onward: **-0.025475 / -0.074345**
- 2028 onward: **0.006393 / 0.019269**
- 2029 YTD: **-0.121361 / -0.331488**

Given the severe recent deterioration and likely redundancy with existing breadth factors, this candidate was **not persisted**.

| Horizon | Valid dates | Average instruments | IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio |

| 1d | 3,230 | 14.98 | -0.008518 | -0.026654 | 48.33% |

Additional metrics:

- Rank turnover: **0.082845**
- Maximum absolute library correlation: **0.962604**
- 20-day admission gates:
  - Absolute IC: **0.040392 ≥ 0.0070**
  - Absolute daily ICIR: **0.123331 ≥ 0.0840**

Regime diagnostics:

- 2020–2025 IC/ICIR: **0.054443 / 0.164625**
- 2026 onward: **0.011308 / 0.035453**
- 2028 onward: **0.045192 / 0.156017**
- 2029 YTD: **-0.049455 / -0.179396**

The factor passes on the full historical sample but has negative 2029 YTD predictive performance. Its very high library correlation indicates that it is primarily a refinement of the existing momentum/residual cluster rather than a diversified source of alpha.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20291115_residual_momentum_20_40.json`

## Current Effective Factors

The newly persisted factor is currently effective on the benchmark-wide historical admission sample:

- **`miner_3_20291115_residual_momentum_20_40`**
  - 20-day IC: **0.040392**
  - Daily ICIR: **0.123331**
  - Coverage: **99.04%**
  - Rank turnover: **0.082845**
  - Last validated: **2029-11-15**
  - Recent-regime status: **caution**
  - Library correlation: **0.962604**

It should be used as a low-weight confirmation or blended momentum overlay rather than a standalone allocation driver.

## Plans

- Revalidate the factor on rolling 3-, 6-, and 12-month windows.
- Test orthogonalization against existing recovery-velocity and residual-momentum artifacts.
- Explore lower-correlation factors based on dispersion, macro resilience, defensive leadership, and volatility-state transitions.
- Maintain conservative use while 2029 YTD IC remains negative across multiple trend and breadth families.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-11-28')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Trend efficiency: directional displacement divided by total absolute path, lagged to prevent look-ahead.
net=px.pct_change(30); path=r.abs().rolling(30,min_periods=22).sum(); f=(net/path).shift(1)
print('factor=30d trend efficiency (net return / sum absolute daily returns), lag1')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); ds.append(px.index[i]); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  x=a[m]; print(' ',lab,'n',len(x),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'rank_turnover',round(f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6),'assets',len(U),'dates',len(px))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291129_trend_efficiency_signal.csv',index=False)
